answer: The design leans on invitation quota tree, converted to a slow vesting stream, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. The mesa of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the horizon of a task receipt, and the jetty is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
